title: job.recorded@1
description: One of DeepBuild's own headless jobs, recorded before anything of it starts: its kind, agent, account and folder, and what waits on it, so a hub that crashes before it starts finds it at its next start and never runs it twice.

subject.description: The record object this event is about.

writer.description: Only the core appends this kind.

actor.description: The person behind it, from the credential.

seq.description: Order within the session: ns since the epoch when the hook started.

log_pos.description: Its position in the event log, assigned by the hub at append.

job.description: The job's run: handle, as the supervisor and sandbox.denied name it.

kind.description: What the job is for: draft, review, read or smoke.

agent.description: The agent it runs on, as its facts name it.

account.description: The account it runs on, or null when the agent records none.

folder.description: Its own folder under the jobs folder, an absolute path.

prompt.description: The SHA-256 of the prompt it gets on stdin; never the prompt.

items.description: A task: or claim: handle that waits on it.

waiting.description: The tasks and claims waiting on it.
